preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT count(*) FROM pg_constraint WHERE conrelid = 'modeling_catalog_model_serving_projection'::regclass AND conname = 'ck_catalog_model_serving_projection'

changeSet.comment: Replace the PostgreSQL-invalid {0,510} repetition with an equivalent column-bounded length check plus an unbounded character allowlist.
changeSet.sql:
ALTER TABLE modeling_catalog_model_serving_projection DROP CONSTRAINT ck_catalog_model_serving_projection;
ALTER TABLE modeling_catalog_model_serving_projection ADD CONSTRAINT ck_catalog_model_serving_projection CHECK ( btrim(tenant_id) <> '' AND catalog_asset_type = 'SEMANTIC_MODEL' AND char_length(catalog_asset_key) BETWEEN 16 AND 512 AND catalog_asset_key ~ '^semantic-model:[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._:-]*$' AND jsonb_typeof(latest_published_ref) = 'object' AND ( serving_ref IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(serving_ref) = 'object' ) AND version > 0 AND sync_status IN ('SYNC_PENDING', 'SYNCED', 'SYNC_FAILED') AND sync_attempts >= 0 AND ( sync_status <> 'SYNC_FAILED' OR (last_sync_error IS NOT NULL AND btrim(last_sync_error) <> '') ) AND updated_at >= created_at );
